purpose: Determine whether already-preserved local artifacts contain the exact historical evidence that Git/GitHub does not preserve, without opening raw LiTS source bytes and without rebuilding Candidate A.

required_inputs.name: preserved_r5_root
required_inputs.description: Local directory for the exact historical Candidate-A R5 root whose physical_root_id must equal e8f37557493b816e4562f5f47df110cf49b429e9ead54e5b624d6638ee07aa3d.

required_inputs.name: original_raw_first_build_receipt
required_inputs.description: The original raw first-build receipt whose SHA-256 is frozen as 89bd0719f0c546bc3e6e0d3ef7678c01c3fb3ab51cf0c82c84f9a343e08d5337.

forbidden_reads: R5 member payload files under members/
exact_checks: member inventory byte length and SHA close to root.json
embedded source content_hash equals canonical LiTS-I SHA 7cac43e2ca5b31cb658dc2b3a6cfbcec99363ca8c47da457df90e31b588efc09
inspect the raw receipt only for independently persisted producer/blob/build-config/operation/reader-config/source-verification/parentage material

success_interpretation.if_raw_receipt_contains_complete_indepen: A later narrowly scoped court may bind that evidence into the current generic R35 verifier, but only without changing its historical facts or borrowing identities from a later build.
success_interpretation.if_raw_receipt_lacks_complete_historical: Historical e8f37557 parentage remains unrecoverable under current R35 law. The preserved root remains semantic/identity evidence only; no rebuild is authorized by this worker.

current_consumer_pin_note.rule: Even if historical evidence is recovered locally, the separate live producer-pin conflict must be reconciled by its lawful owner before current consumer admission.
